title: Psikyo Memories Collection Reveals Full List of Games, February 18 Release
content:
Edia opened the official website for its Psikyo Memories , a collection of '90s arcade scrolling shooter games by Psikyo, on Monday. The company also revealed the full list of games included in the collection, and its February 18, 2027 release for Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5. The game's pre-order also opened on Monday.

The collection will include the following games:

• Strikers 1945

• Strikers 1945 II

• Strikers 1999

• Gunbird

• Gunbird 2

• Gunbarich

• Zero Gunner 2

• Sol Divide: Sword of Darkness

• Dragon Blaze

• Samurai Aces Episode I

• Samurai Aces Episode II: Tengai

• Samurai Aces Episode III: Sengoku Cannon

The game collection will also feature a gallery of archive materials from the games.

Psikyo's arcade shooters have had previous collection releases on the PlayStation 2, PlayStation 4, and Switch. The latest release is Psikyo Shooting Stars Alpha and Psikyo Shooting Stars Bravo , which launched on the Switch in 2020, and on the PS4 in 2022.

Psikyo announced a Psikyo Shooting Collection release for the PlayStation 5 in 2020, but has since not released it. The collection would have included the same 12 works listed above.

title: Macross 7, Synduality: Noir Animator Kenichirō Katsura Dies at 59
content:
Animator Satoko Miyachi announced on her X (formerly Twitter ) account on Monday that her husband, animator Kenichirō Katsura , died on September 30, while undergoing medical treatment for an illness. He was 59.

A private funeral was held with only close relatives in attendance.

Miyachi expressed her deepest thanks to all the fans who loved Katsura's works, the animation studios, and all the staff he worked with throughout his life.

Katsura most recently worked as animation director for Gintama: The Movie 2026: Yoshiwara in Flames (image right), and as key animator for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea . The films opened in Japan on February 13 and February 27, respectively.

Katsura was chief animation director for the two seasons of Synduality: Noir , The Fruit of Grisaia , the second season of Shy (5 episodes), The Eden of Grisaia (10 episodes), How to keep a mummy (9 episodes), and That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (8 episodes), among others.

He also directed the Utawarerumono OAV and the Hi・Me・Go・To OAV.

He was also an episode key animator for anime series such as BLUE LOCK 2nd Season , Date A Live II , Encouragement of Climb seasons 2 & 3, the 1995 Magic Knight Rayearth 2 , Noir , Oishinbo , and the 1989 Ranma ½ series, among others. He was also the key animator for the first part of the Mobile Suit SD Gundam Festival film, and for the OVA episodes of Mobile Suit SD Gundam Mk V and Mobile Suit SD Gundam: SD Gundam Legend .

Katsura also worked as animation director for Macross 7 (4 episodes), as episode director and animation director for the third episode of the Macross 7 Encore OAV , as character designer for Macross 7 Plus , and as character designer and animation character designer for Macross 7 the Movie: The Galaxy's Calling Me! .

The official X/ Twitter account for the Knight's & Magic anime posted its own condolences on Monday. Katsura was the anime's character designer and chief animation director.

title: Manga 'Hirayasumi' Ends in Two Chapters
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter) account for author Keigo Shinzou announced on Monday that the Hirayasumi manga will end in two more chapters.

Shinzou began drawing the manga in Big Comic Spirits in April 2021. Shogakukan published the tenth volume on April 30.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in October 2023, with the latest ninth volume released on May 19.

Hirayasumi was nominated for the 15th and 17th Manga Taisho . The manga also placed among the top 20 titles in the male readers category in the 2023 Kono Manga ga Sugoi! rankings and MyAnimeList's 2024 edition of You Should Read This Manga . The series won the 71st Shogakukan Manga Award in 2026.

A television anime adaptation produced by Production +h. is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.

Synopsis Living in Asagaya, 29-year-old Hiroto Ikuta spends his days working at his part-time job and chatting with the locals. He likes visiting Hanae Wada most, a grumpy yet kind elderly woman whom Hiroto calls "Granny." Hiroto's time with Granny is sadly cut short when she passes away from a heart attack. To his surprise, Hiroto inherits Granny's house as she never married or had children.

Three months later, 18-year-old Natsumi Kobayashi moves from her hometown to attend art school. With nowhere else to go, she stays with her cousin Hiroto, whom she has not seen in years. Despite their opposing personalities, the pair begin living under the same roof as they struggle through their seemingly mundane lives. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

Manga special site: https://bigcomicbros.net/work/48647/ Manga official X (formerly Twitter): @ hirayasumi0426

title: Mikito Chinen's Horror Novel Gets Manga Adaptation
content:
Hiromoto Komatsu launched a manga adaptation of Mikito Chinen 's Etsuran Genkin Ryōki Satsujin-han no Seishin Kantei Hōkoku-sho (Restricted Reading: Psychiatric Evaluation Report of a Bizarre Murderer) horror novel on Futabasha 's Web Comic Action platform on September 25.

The story follows doctor Kasumi Uehara as she conducts the psychiatric examination of the serial killer behind the murders of eleven men and women in Tokyo. As details of the case come to light, so do more questions as she reveals the darkness at the heart of the case.

Futabasha published Chinen's novel in September 2025.

Chinen and artist Kiyo Hasui launched the Prometheus Taisen (Prometheus War) manga on Kadokawa 's ComicWalker platform on June 10.

Chinen and Eri Takenashi ended the Ameku Nakao no Suiri Karute - Sphere no Shitenshi ( The Killer Angel Within: Ameku Takao's Detective Karte ) manga in its third compiled book volume on July 7.

The manga, based on Chinen's Ameku Takao's Detective Karte light novel series, launched in Good! Afternoon in September 2024. Kodansha published the manga's first and second volumes in January and August 2025, respectively.

A television anime of the novels debuted in January 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired and also streams an English dub . Crunchyroll streams the series under the title Ameku M.D.: Doctor Detective .

The novels also inspired a live-action series adaptation, which debuted in April 2025.

Shinchosha published 13 volumes of the novel series from October 2014 to September 2022. Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha has since started re-publishing the 13 previous volumes and adding three more volumes since October 2023. The novel series has over 3 million copies in cumulative circulation.

title: Yuki Kure's Ayame-san Chi no Geshuku-nin Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content:
The November issue of Hakusensha 's LaLa DX magazine revealed on Monday that Yuki Kure 's Ayame-san Chi no Geshuku-nin ( Ayame's House Lodger ) manga will end with its next chapter in the magazine's next issue on December 4 (the magazine publishes a new issue every two months).

The manga's story centers on Megumi, a high school girl who becomes the owner of an apartment complex, and she finds five handsome, quirky men as lodgers.

Kure launched the manga in LaLa DX in June 2025. Hakusensha released the manga's first compiled book volume on April 3.

Kure launched the Kin-iro no Corda Daigakusei-hen (La Corda d'Oro College Arc) manga in LaLa DX in December 2017.

The "Multiending Arc" launched in LaLa DX in June 2021. The new arc portrays four different parallel "endings" to the original La Corda d'Oro story with Kahoko ending up with each of the four male leads of the story: Tsuchiura, Shimizu, Yunoki, and Hihara.

The "Multiending Arc" ended in 2022, and entered its "Encore Arc" in February 2023, which depicted the epilogues of each respective ending shown in the "Multiending Arc." Hakusensha published the manga's eighth compiled book volume in March 2024, which contains the "Encore Arc."

Kure's first manga adaptation of KOEI 's original La Corda d'Oro game ended in 2011. Viz Media published the 17-volume series in North America. Kure also drew the following manga for the franchise : Linden Hall no Aria -Kin-iro no Corda Series- (Linden Hall Aria: La Corda d'Oro Series), La Corda d'Oro Blue Sky , and La Corda d'Oro 4 .

title: Chanta Launches Noro-Noro Puku-Puku Manga
content:
Manga creator Chanta launched a new manga titled Noro-Noro Puku-Puku in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ manga service on Monday. The manga is available in English on Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service. MANGA Plus describes the manga:

An exceptionally cursed shrine maiden, Suzu, incurs the divine punishment of the gods one day... And her curse? To exorcise 108 curses with the help of Puku, the black cat possessing her head! Chanta of "Sachi's Records 〜Sachi's Book of Revelation〜" presents this jaw-dropping absurdist exorcist comedy!

Chanta launched the Sachi's Records: Sachi's Book of Revelation ( Sachi-roku: Sachi no Mokushiroku ) manga in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ website in July 2023, and ended it in April 2025. Shueisha published the manga's fifth and final compiled book volume in July 2025. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service released the manga in English.
author: ANN

title: Naoki Shigeno to End Sanada Damashii Manga in 6th Volume
content:
Hakusensha is listing the sixth volume of Naoki Shigeno 's Sanada Damashii manga series as the final volume. The volume will ship on November 27.

The series is a four-panel comic depicting the activities of the Sanada clan in the Sengoku period.

Shigeno launched the series on Hakusensha 's Young Animal Densi platform in 2015, where it ran until 2017. It later switched to Hakusensha 's Manga Park platform. Hakusensha shipped the fifth compiled book volume in April 2025.

Shigeno launched the Nobunaga no Shinobi ( Ninja Girl & Samurai Master ) manga in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in 2008, and ended it on July 25, 2025. Hakusensha published the manga's first volume in 2009. Hakusensha published the three-volume spinoff manga titled Nobunaga no Shinobi Gaiden: Owari Tōitsu-ki (Nobunaga's Shinobi - Chronicle of Owari's Unification) from 2014 to 2017. The original manga inspired a television anime in 2016. The anime's 26-episode second season premiered in 2017, and the third season premiered in 2018. Crunchyroll streamed all three seasons of the anime.

title: Nijū-Mensō no Musume's Shinji Ohara Launches New Manga
content:
Shinji Ohara launched a new manga titled Moto-Shojo Tantei, Yamada Chizuko: Saigo no Jiken kara Sūjūnengo (Former Girl-Detective, Chizuko Yamada: A Few Decades After the Final Case) on Shogakukan 's Yawaraka Spirits platform on September 30.

The story follows Kazuo Sasauchi, a young man who moves to Osaka to attend college and therefore moves into in an old western-styled house there. He meets the house's owner who is his great-aunt: the kimono-wearing, cigarette-smoking Chizuko Yamada. She is a former girl-detective whose past returns to haunt her.

Ohara ended the first Chiko, Heiress of the Phantom Thief ( Nijū-Mensō no Musume ) manga in 2007 after five years and eight volumes. Ohara launched the spinoff series Nijū-Mensō no Musume : Utsushiyo Yoru in Media Factory 's Monthly Comic Flapper in October 2007. Kadokawa published the 11th and final volume in 2014. The stories are loosely based on the Kaijin Nijū-Mensō (The Fiend with 20 Faces) novels by the famed suspense and detective novelist, Ranpo Edogawa. The first manga series inspired a television anime in April 2008.

title: K Manga Offers Adachitoka's The Wolf at Memory's End Manga in English
content:
K MANGA announced on Saturday that it will release Adachitoka 's The Wolf at Memory's End ( Yadoya no Oinu-sama ) manga in English on October 5.

Adachitoka is launching the manga in Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Magazine on October 6.

The story follows Kasumi Kuromine, a junior high school girl who resides in the countryside. One day, an accident happens during a school field trip, and she falls down the mountainside.

Adachitoka launched the Noragami: Stray God manga in Monthly Shonen Magazine in 2010, and ended the series in January 2024. Kodansha shipped the 27th and final volume in February 2024. The manga inspired a 12-episode television anime series that premiered in January 2014. Funimation streamed the series as it aired and released it on home video. The anime's second season, titled Noragami Aragoto , debuted in October 2015, and Funimation also streamed that series as it aired and released it on home video.

Kodansha released the first volume of Noragami: Stray Stories in Japan in November 2013. BONES adapted one of the stories from the manga as an original anime DVD that shipped with the 15th volume of the manga in Japan.

title: Chained Soldier Manga Goes on Hiatus Due to Artist Yōhei Takemura's Health
content:
Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ manga website announced on Saturday that writer Takahiro and artist Yōhei Takemura 's Chained Soldier ( Mato Seihei no Slave or literally, Slave of the Magic Capital's Elite Troops) manga will go on hiatus due to artist Takemura's poor health. In a statement, Takemura said that they injured their right wrist in June, specifically damage to the fibrocartilage. Takemura added that they have been drawing while wearing a brace, but drawing places a heavy strain on their wrist, causing pain and impeding recovery. Takemura added that full recovery requires a long period of time, and they have decided to stop working on the manga's drafts to allow their wrist to heal.

The editorial staff of Shonen Jump+ reported that the manga is scheduled to resume on November 14, but Takemura's recovery is top priority, and added that the manga's pace in the future will be determined in consultation with Takahiro and Takemura, and based on medical advice.

The battle fantasy is set in a world where a demonic gate has unleashed monsters known as Shūki. A special peach tree is able to give special powers, but only to women. The story begins when a down-on-his-luck boy named Yūki Wakura meets Uzen Kyōka, a girl who has gained the power of the peach, and is the captain of the 7th Anti-Demon Squad.

Takahiro ( Akame ga KILL! ) and Takemura ( Papa no Iu Koto o Kikinasai! manga) launched the manga on Shonen Jump+ manga website in January 2019. Yen Press publishes the manga in English.

The first season of the manga's anime adaptation premiered in Japan in January 2024. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired, and also streamed an English dub . The second season premiered on January 8. HIDIVE also streamed the second season as it aired, and also streamed an English dub . A third season is in the works.
